title: Mail: multi-MIME, inline quote, duplicate Message-ID, ancestors and missing references
annotator: claude-sonnet-5.5 worker, hand annotation on 2026-10-24 (human-style reading; no program produced any expected value)
independence_statement: Message bodies are short synthetic texts written by hand. Contributed text, quoted text, ancestor lists and missing references were decided by reading each body as a person would. No parser, grouping code or A2 code was run or imported.

sources: docs/notes/preparation-semantics.md: 'Grouping relationship conventions' (in_reply_to, outlook_conversation, missing parent, cycles)

tests/outlook_mail_handoff_fixtures.py (A1 accepted mail fixture shapes, read only)

cases.title: multipart/alternative: plain and HTML carry the same contribution

parts.text: Please review the draft by Friday.

expected.contributed_text: Please review the draft by Friday.

cases.rationale: Both alternatives say the same thing. A reader sees one sentence, so the contribution is counted once.

cases.title: Inline quote under a reply: only the new lines are contributed

expected.contributed_text: I reviewed it. Section 2 is unclear.
expected.quoted_text: Please review the draft by Friday.

cases.rationale: Lines marked with '>' repeat message m1. The attribution line is neither contribution nor quote body.
